name: Largemouth Bass
quick_pattern: Fish cover, weed edges, shade, and low-light feeding windows. Slow down when sunny or post-front.

name: Smallmouth Bass
quick_pattern: Focus on rock, current breaks, riprap, and moving water. Natural colors and compact baits work well in clear water.

name: Bluegill
quick_pattern: Use small hooks, light line, wax worms, red worms, or tiny jigs near weeds, docks, and shoreline cover.

name: Crappie
quick_pattern: Fish small jigs or minnows around brush, timber, docks, and suspended fish. Slow presentations are usually best.

name: Channel Catfish
quick_pattern: Use bottom rigs with cut bait, stink bait, worms, or chicken liver near current breaks, deeper holes, and evening feeding areas.

name: Flathead Catfish
quick_pattern: Use heavier tackle and live bait near wood, deep holes, log jams, and current breaks, especially at night.

name: Walleye
quick_pattern: Fish low light, wind-blown structure, riprap, current seams, and dropoffs with jigs, minnows, or spoons.

name: Sauger
quick_pattern: Use jig-and-minnow rigs or blade-style presentations near tailwaters, current seams, and river channel edges.

name: Northern Pike
quick_pattern: Use wire leader, larger moving baits, spoons, spinnerbaits, or big minnows around weeds, bays, and ambush edges.

name: Muskie
quick_pattern: Use heavy tackle, wire leader, large baits, and figure-eight boatside. Focus on major structure and feeding windows.

name: Rainbow Trout
quick_pattern: Use small spoons, inline spinners, micro jigs, worms, or PowerBait-style bottom/float rigs in stocked waters.

name: Brown Trout
quick_pattern: Use small spoons, minnow-style baits, or subtle jigs near cool-water edges, structure, harbors, and current breaks.

name: Yellow Perch
quick_pattern: Use small minnows, worms, or tiny jigs near schools, bottom transitions, weeds, and harbor areas.

name: White Bass
quick_pattern: Look for baitfish activity, current, wind-blown banks, and schooling fish. Spoons, small jigs, and minnow baits work well.

name: Common Carp
quick_pattern: Use bottom rigs with corn, dough bait, or worms. Fish quietly around shallow flats, mud edges, and warm-water areas.

name: Coho Salmon
quick_pattern: Use spoons, crank/minnow baits, or spawn-style presentations around Lake Michigan harbors, piers, and shoreline movement.

name: Chinook Salmon
quick_pattern: Use heavier spoons, plugs, or minnow-style baits around Lake Michigan staging areas and low-light windows.
